partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Phenotype-mimicry-gated anatomy dual-target module
results.hypothesis: An anatomy-localized dual-target mechanism is more credible when the drug is not known to reproduce an exact phenotype of the predicted disease.
results.body: R113 excluding direct adverse disease edges and exact drug-side-effect/disease-phenotype overlap
results.mechanism_rationale: The positive rule supplies multi-target, pathway, and tissue convergence; the exclusion removes graph-native evidence that the drug reproduces the disease phenotype.
results.trapi_notes: The positive and adverse motifs are separately TRAPI-expressible; cardinality, shared anatomy, provenance, degree, and absence constraints require Cypher.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene1:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect1:AFFECTS]->(gene1)
MATCH (gene1)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene2:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect2:AFFECTS]->(gene2)
MATCH (gene2)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
MATCH (gene1)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process)<-[:INVOLVED_IN]-(gene2)
MATCH (gene1)-[expression1:EXPRESSED_IN]->(anatomy:AnatomicalEntity)
MATCH (gene2)-[expression2:EXPRESSED_IN]->(anatomy)
MATCH (object)-[:LOCATED_IN|OCCURS_IN]->(anatomy)
WHERE gene1.id < gene2.id
  AND effect1.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect1.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect1.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND effect2.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect2.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect2.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND 'infores:bgee' IN coalesce(expression1.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND 'infores:bgee' IN coalesce(expression2.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND process._miner_gene_member_degree <= 100
  AND anatomy._miner_disease_location_degree <= 50
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:CONTRAINDICATED_IN|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|CAUSES]->(object)
  }
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(:PhenotypicFeature)
          <-[:HAS_PHENOTYPE]-(object)
  }
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Ontology-aware phenotype-mimicry-gated anatomy module
results.hypothesis: Side-effect negative evidence should include closely related phenotype terms rather than requiring exact HPO identity.
results.body: R113 excluding direct adverse edges and side-effect/disease phenotypes sharing a specific ancestor within two ontology steps
results.mechanism_rationale: The exclusion catches ontology-near adverse phenotypes while restricting ancestors to non-hub terms, but phenotype similarity can also remove tolerable on-target effects.
results.trapi_notes: Bounded phenotype paths are TRAPI-expressible; negative existential logic, shared ancestors, cardinality, provenance, and degree constraints require Cypher.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene1:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect1:AFFECTS]->(gene1)
MATCH (gene1)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene2:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect2:AFFECTS]->(gene2)
MATCH (gene2)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
MATCH (gene1)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process)<-[:INVOLVED_IN]-(gene2)
MATCH (gene1)-[expression1:EXPRESSED_IN]->(anatomy:AnatomicalEntity)
MATCH (gene2)-[expression2:EXPRESSED_IN]->(anatomy)
MATCH (object)-[:LOCATED_IN|OCCURS_IN]->(anatomy)
WHERE gene1.id < gene2.id
  AND effect1.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect1.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect1.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND effect2.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect2.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect2.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND 'infores:bgee' IN coalesce(expression1.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND 'infores:bgee' IN coalesce(expression2.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND process._miner_gene_member_degree <= 100
  AND anatomy._miner_disease_location_degree <= 50
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:CONTRAINDICATED_IN|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|CAUSES]->(object)
  }
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(side_effect:PhenotypicFeature)
    MATCH (object)-[:HAS_PHENOTYPE]->(disease_phenotype:PhenotypicFeature)
    MATCH (side_effect)-[:SUBCLASS_OF*0..2]->(ancestor:PhenotypicFeature)
          <-[:SUBCLASS_OF*0..2]-(disease_phenotype)
    WHERE coalesce(ancestor._miner_phenotype_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  }
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Adverse-phenotype-gated direct GOF inhibition
results.hypothesis: Direct correction of a gain-of-function disease mechanism is more credible when graph-native adverse evidence does not reproduce the disease.
results.body: R160 excluding direct adverse disease edges and exact drug-side-effect/disease-phenotype overlap
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule preserves explicit drug and disease direction while using direct adverse and phenotype-mimicry evidence as vetoes.
results.trapi_notes: The positive and adverse motifs are separately TRAPI-expressible; source, variant-form, ontology, and absence constraints require Cypher.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)
WHERE 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier =
      'gain_of_function_variant_form'
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:CONTRAINDICATED_IN|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|CAUSES]->(object)
  }
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(:PhenotypicFeature)
          <-[:HAS_PHENOTYPE]-(object)
  }
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Phenotype-mimicry-gated dual-target peer transfer
results.hypothesis: Dual-target indication transfer is more credible when the candidate drug is not known to reproduce an exact phenotype of the transferred disease.
results.body: R119 excluding direct adverse disease edges and exact candidate-side-effect/disease-phenotype overlap
results.mechanism_rationale: The positive rule transfers through two shared directional targets; the gate rejects direct or phenotype-level adverse evidence for the candidate.
results.trapi_notes: The positive and adverse motifs are separately TRAPI-expressible; treatment-source exclusion, two-target cardinality, ontology, and absence constraints require Cypher.
results.cypher:
MATCH (peer:Drug)-[treatment:TREATS|AMELIORATES_CONDITION]->(object:Disease)
WHERE any(
  source IN coalesce(treatment.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  WHERE NOT source IN ['infores:drug-repurposing-hub', 'infores:ttd']
)
MATCH (peer)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene1:Gene)
MATCH (peer)-[peer_effect1:AFFECTS]->(gene1)
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene1)
MATCH (subject)-[subject_effect1:AFFECTS]->(gene1)
MATCH (gene1)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
MATCH (peer)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene2:Gene)
MATCH (peer)-[peer_effect2:AFFECTS]->(gene2)
MATCH (subject)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene2)
MATCH (subject)-[subject_effect2:AFFECTS]->(gene2)
MATCH (gene2)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
WHERE subject <> peer
  AND gene1.id < gene2.id
  AND peer_effect1.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND peer_effect1.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND peer_effect1.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND subject_effect1.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND subject_effect1.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND subject_effect1.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND peer_effect2.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND peer_effect2.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND peer_effect2.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND subject_effect2.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND subject_effect2.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND subject_effect2.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:CONTRAINDICATED_IN|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|CAUSES]->(object)
  }
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(:PhenotypicFeature)
          <-[:HAS_PHENOTYPE]-(object)
  }
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
